description: Cold-start byte budgets for the DT, BRD, PRD, ADR, and planner chain. Bytes cover the agent file, its recursive #file: imports, and always-on instructions, with CRLF normalized to LF. Above ceiling fails; above target warns. Targets are the measured cold-start bytes when the check was introduced, rounded up to the next 1,000; ceilings add about 10 percent, rounded up to the next 1,000, to absorb growth in shared files such as disclaimer-language.instructions.md, unless an entry's rationale preserves an earlier limit. Raise a ceiling only for growth in a shared file the agent does not own.

.github/agents/accessibility/accessibili.rationale: Measured 22,492 bytes; the agent has no #file: imports, so growth is the agent's own.

.github/agents/design-thinking/dt-coach..rationale: Measured 38,380 bytes including the shared disclaimer-language import.

.github/agents/privacy/privacy-planner.a.rationale: Measured 34,819 bytes including privacy-identity and the shared disclaimer-language import.

.github/agents/project-planning/adr-crea.rationale: Measured 45,424 bytes including adr-identity and the shared disclaimer-language import; keeps the retired harness's 48,000-byte ceiling rather than the uniform 10 percent rule, preserving that earlier limit.

.github/agents/project-planning/brd-buil.rationale: Measured 35,676 bytes including the shared disclaimer-language import.

.github/agents/project-planning/prd-buil.rationale: Measured 50,309 bytes including the shared disclaimer-language import.

.github/agents/rai-planning/rai-planner..rationale: Measured 79,445 bytes including rai-identity, planner-identity-base, and the shared disclaimer-language import; rai-identity is the largest share and the main reduction candidate.

.github/agents/security/sssc-planner.age.rationale: Measured 41,059 bytes including the shared disclaimer-language import.
